moves.label: Kyubi Chakra Jab
moves.description: Fast high chakra jab with a tiny active window for close checks.
moves.reason: Compact red chakra-cloak strike at upper-body height.

moves.label: Low Chakra Tail Sweep
moves.description: Slow low chakra-tail sweep with moderate active time and steady recovery.
